question: {If } cot A = (3)/(4), { then find the value of } 3 sin2 A - cos3 A { is:}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

cot A = 3/4 ⇒ tan A = 4/3 ⇒ triangle: opposite = 4, adjacent = 3, hypotenuse = 5

sin A = 4/5, cos A = 3/5

sin2A = 2 × sinA × cosA = 2 × 4/5 × 3/5 = 24/25

cos3A = 4cos³A − 3cosA = 4 × (3/5)³ − 3 × 3/5 = 108/125 − 9/5 = −117/125

⇒ 3(24/25) - (- 117/125)

⇒ 477/125

**∴ Answer = 477/125**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cot A = 3/4

**Formula used:**

sin2A = 2sinA cosA

cos3A = 4cos³A − 3cosA

 
 A B C 3 4 5 

**Calculations:**

⇒ cot A = adjacent/opposite = 3/4

⇒ sin A = 4/5, cos A = 3/5

⇒ sin2A = 2 × 4/5 × 3/5 = 24/25

⇒ cos3A = 4 × (3/5)³ − 3 × 3/5

⇒ = 108/125 − 9/5 = 108/125 − 225/125 = −117/125

⇒ 3sin2A − cos3A = 3 × 24/25 − (−117/125)

⇒ = 72/25 + 117/125 = 360/125 + 117/125 = 477/125

**∴ The correct answer is 477/125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

sin2A Formula

sin2A = 2sinA cosA, useful when sinA and cosA are known.

cos3A Identity

cos3A = 4cos³A − 3cosA, commonly used in higher trig expressions.

Right Triangle Approach

Convert ratios like cot into triangle sides to easily get sin and cos.

Alternative Identity

cos3A can also be written as 4cos³A − 3cosA or 1 − 4sin²A cosA depending on need.
